source.heading: Data Source
source.notePre: These are the ways CpapDash reads your SD card. ResMed myAir is not one of them: it only reports a summary of each night, not the recordings the charts and reports are built from. You can still connect it, under
source.notePost: below, to compare ResMed's numbers against CpapDash's.
source.archiveMissing: Not set. Your {{device}} downloads files that need somewhere to land, so nothing is being written to disk: OSCAR has nothing to import and SleepHQ export stays blocked. Nights already collected are safe in the database and appear here as normal.
source.archiveHint: Where collected nights are written, as a card layout (STR.edf and DATALOG/ side by side). Point OSCAR's card import here. Use forward slashes on Windows, e.g. C:/Users/you/CPAPData

logging.heading: Support Log
logging.hint: Keeps a copy of everything the service prints, so it can be sent when something goes wrong. Leave the file blank to use the default: next to the program if that folder is writable, otherwise beside config.json.

o2ring.heading: O2 Ring Oximetry
o2ring.muleHint: IP of the mule C3 bridging the O2 Ring via BLE
o2ring.bleOk: Bluetooth adapter detected. BLE direct mode ready.
o2ring.bleNoAdapter: No Bluetooth adapter detected. Plug in a USB BLE adapter.
o2ring.bleNotCompiled: BLE support not compiled. Rebuild with -DBUILD_WITH_BLE=ON.

sleephq.heading: SleepHQ Sync
sleephq.desc: Forward your therapy nights to SleepHQ via their public API. Create API credentials in SleepHQ under Account → API.
sleephq.autoSession: Upload automatically when a session completes
sleephq.autoBackfill: Upload automatically when importing local data
sleephq.quietHint: How long the archive must stop changing before a night is exported, so a night still being written is not sent early.

myair.heading: ResMed myAir
myair.desc: Read your own nights back from ResMed and show their score next to CpapDash's, per night and per component. Read only: nothing is ever written back to ResMed.
myair.notePre: Your password is used once to sign in and is
myair.notePost: . ResMed issues a revocable token that replaces it, which can only read this account's sleep data and cannot sign in as you anywhere.
myair.needsReauth: The saved token is no longer valid, so myAir has been disconnected. Sign in again to reconnect.
myair.disconnectHint: Disconnecting forgets the token. Nights already fetched are kept.

cloud.heading: CpapDash Cloud
cloud.desc: Mirror your equipment and supplies to your CpapDash account. Your local install stays the source of truth, and turning this off leaves the equipment feature working exactly as it does now.
cloud.tokenHint: Stored redacted. Leave the masked value untouched to keep the current token. A token can be revoked without changing your account password.
cloud.autoSync: Also sync on the collection sweep after local edits

sleepStage.heading: Sleep Stage Inference
sleepStage.live: Infer during the night, not only once it ends
sleepStage.modelDirPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the data directory

agent.heading: Agent
agent.unavailable: Unavailable: the agent needs LLM Summaries enabled and a PostgreSQL database.

backfill.heading: Import History
backfill.desc: Import therapy sessions from your DATALOG directory into the database. Existing sessions in the date range will be re-parsed.
backfill.emptyHint: Leave empty to import all available data.

mqtt.heading: MQTT
mqtt.clientIdHint: Changing only this does not take effect until the service restarts.

llm.heading: LLM Summaries
llm.openaiHint: Any server speaking the OpenAI chat API: OpenAI itself, OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp, or Ollama's own /v1 surface. Put its base URL in Endpoint.
llm.apiKeyPlaceholder: Optional for Ollama and most local servers
llm.promptFilePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in prompt

advanced.heading: Advanced
advanced.webPortHint: This is the port serving this page. After saving and restarting, this tab moves itself to the new port. If the new port is blocked or already in use, the app becomes unreachable in the browser and you would have to fix it in config.json.
advanced.staticLocked: Locked. This is where the web interface itself is served from, and a wrong value serves no interface at all. Click the field to unlock.
advanced.staticHint: Leave empty to let the app find its own bundle.
advanced.confirm:
Change the static directory?

This is where the web interface itself is served from. A wrong value serves no interface at all, and recovering means editing config.json by hand.

Leave it empty unless you know you need it.

restart.banner: Saved, but not yet in effect.
restart.reason: You changed {{list}}, which the running service only picks up on a restart.
restart.portMove: This page will move to port {{port}}.
restart.noAnswer: No answer on {{origin}}. The port may be blocked or already in use.
restart.noComeback: The service did not come back. Check that it is running.
restart.manual: Restart hms-cpap for these settings to take effect.
restart.manualBody: This install cannot restart itself, so it has to be done the same way it was started.
